justifications.durability: the two reinstated guards at tests/test_a_merge_repaired_run_is_judged_on_its_own_changes.py:114-118 and :132-136 would redden with "DID NOT RAISE CrewError" if reckon/crew/runs.py:2162's DEFAULT_EXCLUSIVE_PATHS or _changed_artifacts_needing_acceptance at reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:585 stopped matching docs/plans/*.html, and each assertion compares the refusal message against git-discovered paths rather than a value the test handed crew.complete.
justifications.evidence: red-file-arm-head.log's header names its revision, tree and command and its last two lines read "8 passed in 4.81s" and EXIT=0, while red-file-arm-base.log reads "2 failed, 6 passed" EXIT=1 and the manifest records 58 passed EXIT=0 on both suite arms — though no log line states the all_debug partition the done_when names.
justifications.fit: the comment at tests/test_a_merge_repaired_run_is_judged_on_its_own_changes.py:107-110 states the rule in the file's own voice and ruff check plus ruff format --check report nothing on the head file, though the new fragment at docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/red-file-a-merge-repaired-run-is-judged-on-its-own-changes.html:1-2 opens unindented with an h3 where its sibling qwnw-red-file-a-merged-primary-run-keeps-its-own-commits.html:1-2 indents two spaces under an h2.

justifications.reuse: the diff adds no function, class or module — the tests reach the existing owner reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:585 and take the exclusive classes from reckon/crew/runs.py:2162 rather than restating them, and a search over reckon for a second copy of the pattern list found only that one constant, which unmergeable_patterns also builds on.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 2f00851c..6d4cb77bbc touches only tests/test_a_merge_repaired_run_is_judged_on_its_own_changes.py and the fragment under docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/, both inside the declared tests and fragment directories.
